# ankra_aws_instance_types (Data Source)

The EC2 instance types offered in a region, for the `*_type` arguments of `ankra_aws_cluster` and `ankra_node_group`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_aws_instance_types" "frankfurt" {
  credential_id = ankra_aws_role_credential.main.id
  region        = "eu-central-1"
}

locals {
  arm_types = [for type in data.ankra_aws_instance_types.frankfurt.instance_types : type.name if type.architecture == "arm64"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.
- `region` (String) AWS region, e.g. `eu-central-1` (`data.ankra_aws_regions`).

### Read-Only

- `instance_types` (Attributes List) Instance types offered in the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_types))

<a id="nestedatt--instance_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instance_types`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String) CPU architecture, e.g. `x86_64` or `arm64`.
- `category` (String) Instance family category.
- `current_generation` (Boolean) Whether the type is current generation.
- `hourly_price_usd` (Number) On-demand hourly price in USD; null when the price is unknown.
- `memory_gib` (Number) Memory in GiB.
- `monthly_price_usd` (Number) Monthly price in USD; null when the price is unknown.
- `name` (String) Instance type, e.g. `m7i.large`.
- `vcpus` (Number) vCPUs.
